name: LAGET DISCOVERY ONE flagship
why_interesting: Fully 3D-printed titanium gravel frameset with 50 mm clearance, a documented 1.45 kg size-S frame and UDH.

facts.frame_weight_basis: Current official page lists 1.45 kg for size S but does not state whether fork or hardware are included or provide a weighing protocol.
facts.frame: Fully 3D-printed titanium frame with carbon fork and UDH
facts.frame_material: 3D-printed titanium frame; exact titanium alloy grade is not published The current 2026-09-23 product page does not restate the alloy; retain the material claim as the earlier dated official observation.
facts.frame_construction: Fully 3D-printed gravel frame with sandblasted finish and anodized logo
facts.stiffness_evidence: No exact-model instrumented stiffness result or sufficiently specific independent ride assessment was found after the 50-area sweep; 3D-printing and strength language was not converted into a stiffness claim.
facts.official_retail_price_basis: Listed official retail price observed 2026-09-23; not a checkout quote.

observed_price.price_basis: Selected S-size anodized-gold flagship frameset, SKU 6246437678731; CNY 26,000 before the displayed CNY 100 coupon

missing: Mainland warranty issuer and invoice handling for the selected Taobao listing

source_note: The 2026-08-27 official observation described a fully 3D-printed titanium frame; the exact alloy grade was not stated.
